description: Residuos peligrosos por actividad productiva is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Corporación Autónoma Regional del Centro de Antioquia, Antioquia. Información que contiene la cantidad de residuos peligrosos generados por actividad productiva (CIIU), correspondiente hasta el período 2024, en la jurisdicción de Corantioquia. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Corporación Autónoma Regional del Centro de Antioquia, Antioquia. Its tags are residuos, residuos peligrosos. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible. The portal shows 2026-04-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
